# How much employer FICA tip credit can your restaurant or salon claim?

> Free FICA tip credit calculator for restaurants, bars and salons: estimate your Form 8846 credit per employee from cash wage, hours and tips, see the after-tax value and what unclaimed prior years may be worth. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
